about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client in Paola for a detail-oriented and organised Accounting Officer to join their growing Finance and Administration Department. You will support daily accounting and administrative operations, ensuring accuracy, efficiency and compliance with applicable financial and tax regulations.

Your work will cover accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations and general ledger entries, monthly and annual closing (accruals, deferrals and adjusting entries), routine tax compliance including VAT, F24 filings and withholding taxes, fixed asset records and depreciation, and support during internal and external audits.

The role suits an accountant with 2–3 years of experience who is fluent in both Italian and English and enjoys precise, well-organised work. It is a full-time, on-site position paying €25,000–€30,000 per year, open to candidates currently residing in Malta.
responsibilities: Process, verify and record accounts payable and receivable invoices
Perform bank reconciliations and maintain accurate general ledger entries
Assist with monthly and annual financial closing, including accruals, deferrals and adjusting entries
Support routine tax compliance, including VAT, F24 filings and withholding taxes
Maintain fixed asset records and calculate depreciation
Liaise with suppliers, customers and external consultants on accounting matters
Maintain accurate financial records and ensure proper document filing and archiving
Provide documentation and assistance during internal and external audits
Support the Finance and Administration Department with other accounting and administrative duties as required
requirements: Diploma in Accounting, degree in Economics or a related qualification
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in accounting or a similar role
Solid understanding of accounting principles and applicable tax regulations
Fluency in both Italian and English, written and spoken, is essential
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting or ERP software
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Reliable, proactive and able to work independently and as part of a team
Availability to work on-site (remote working is not offered)
